entries.note: The order was created but not taken in, often for missing or wrong details. GHTK's page on order statuses explains it.
The order is created; pickup is not yet due. GHTK's page on order statuses explains it.

entries.wording: Đơn đã điều phối lấy hàng / Đang lấy hàng
entries.note: A courier is assigned to collect the parcel. The page lists the two names together. GHTK's page on order statuses explains it.

entries.wording: Đã lấy hàng, đã nhập kho
entries.note: Picked up and received into a GHTK warehouse. GHTK's page on order statuses explains it.
Pickup did not happen in this shift and moves to the next one. GHTK's page on order statuses explains it.
Pickup failed and the order is cancelled. GHTK's page on order statuses explains it.

entries.wording: Đơn đã điều phối giao hàng / Đang giao hàng
entries.note: The page lists the two names together. GHTK's page on order statuses explains it.
Not delivered in this shift; another attempt follows. GHTK's page on order statuses explains it.

entries.wording: Lưu kho chờ doanh nghiệp kiểm tra
entries.note: Delivery failed; the parcel is held while the merchant checks it. GHTK's page on order statuses explains it.

entries.wording: Đơn đã giao hàng / Chưa đối soát
entries.note: Delivered; the cash on delivery is not yet settled with the merchant. GHTK's page on order statuses explains it.
Delivered and settled with the merchant. GHTK's page on order statuses explains it.

entries.wording: Đơn đối soát công nợ trả hàng
entries.note: Returned after a failed delivery; the fees are settled. GHTK's page on order statuses explains it.
GHTK compensates the merchant for a parcel lost or damaged in its care. GHTK's page on order statuses explains it.
Moving between warehouses and post offices. Hoàng Hà Mobile's guide to GHTK tracking lists it.
